recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片充滿中型母細胞，細胞質灰藍、無顆粒，部分有細胞質突起；切片瀰漫浸潤並呈 TCL1、CD123、CD56 陽性，流式也呈單一族群，符合瀰漫散播型母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤 (BPDCN)。
features: Panel A: sheets of medium-sized blasts with fine chromatin, round to irregular nuclei and moderate agranular grey-blue cytoplasm; insets show clot/biopsy infiltrate and blasts with cytoplasmic projections
Panel B: diffuse strong TCL1 positivity in the marrow infiltrate
Panels E-F: flow cytometry plots showing a single dominant tight population (axis labels not legible)
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate is replaced by medium-sized blasts with fine chromatin, irregular nuclear contours and moderate agranular cytoplasm, some with pseudopod-like cytoplasmic projections. The biopsy shows a diffuse infiltrate that is strongly positive for TCL1, CD123 and CD56 by immunohistochemistry, and flow cytometry demonstrates a single dominant abnormal population (axis labels are not legible in this figure). Findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm with extensive marrow involvement.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: AML may express CD56 and CD123 but is MPO/lysozyme or CD14/CD11c positive and usually TCL1 and TCF4 negative.
NK/T-cell lymphoma is CD56+ but EBER positive with cytoplasmic CD3ε and cytotoxic granules, and lacks CD123/TCL1.
T-ALL blasts express TdT and cytoplasmic CD3, not the CD4/CD56/CD123/TCL1 combination.

stain: Wright-Giemsa; IHC: TCL1, CD123, CD56; flow cytometry
